Subject: StellarBay pilot — brief recap & next asks

Hi Marta — great to meet earlier. Quick written recap from today’s discovery call and two asks to keep momentum: 

Recap (30m call):
- Use case: embedding search + assistant inside internal docs for SRE and support teams (initial scope 50k documents).
- Success metrics: reduce support TTR by 25% and surface correct KB article within top-3 results 80% of the time.
- Pilot constraints: must run in our US cloud region; data residency acceptable in US; security evidence required (SOC2 basics + vendor questionnaire).

Asks / next steps: 
1) Can you confirm who the economic decision owner is for this project (title + email)? we want to loop them into the pilot scoping call so we align on ROI and budget.
2) Can you share procurement/PO instructions and the right procurement contact for vendor onboarding?

Attached: SOW-draft.pdf (light pilot scope + milestones) and redwood-security-snapshot.pdf (SOC 2 + checklist).

Proposed immediate next step: 30-minute scoping call with your econ buyer + procurement. I’m available next Tue/Wed morning PT — happy to send a calendar invite once you confirm names.

Thanks and talk soon,
Rishi
